description: Use this when the user wants to know whether a clip is cut or rendered, or wants the finished file. Pass the job_id from make_clips or restyle_clip, or a clip_id for that clip's latest render. Returns the status, progress, a still from the clip and, when finished, a short download link. Pass wait: true to hold on up to about 40 seconds for it to finish. Do not use for transcribe_audio jobs.

clip_id.description: A cut clip, for its latest render.

wait.description: Wait briefly for it to finish instead of reporting now.

name: get_job

clips.description: For a cut: the clips it made, and the render that follows each.

download_url.description: A short link that downloads the MP4. Good for 7 days.

title: Get a clip job
